# chock-quickstart

> Blocks your coding agent's wrong moves before they land.

This GitHub template repository is the exact tree `chock init .` writes into an empty repo, with no policies installed.

## README

- [Install](README.md#install): the repository route and the plugin route
- [How it works](README.md#how-it-works): what `chock init .` wrote and how to turn on your first guards
- [What it stops](README.md#what-it-stops)
- [Guardrails, not guarantees](README.md#guardrails-not-guarantees)
- [FAQ for people and agents](README.md#faq-for-people-and-agents)
- [For tools and agents](README.md#for-tools-and-agents): machine-readable sources
- [Contributing](README.md#contributing)

## Docs

- [chock.sh docs](https://chock.sh/docs): the Chock documentation
